description: This Java class 'ByConditionFinder' extends 'ListFinder' and is part of the Apache OFBiz framework. It is responsible for constructing entity conditions based on XML elements such as 'condition-expr', 'condition-list', and 'condition-object', which are used for querying entities with specified conditions. The class manages 'where' and 'having' SQL-like conditions for entity retrieval.

classes.name: ByConditionFinder
classes.description: A finder class that constructs entity query conditions based on XML configuration, supporting 'where' and 'having' conditions.

methods.name: getWhereEntityCondition
methods.description: Generates the 'where' condition for the entity query based on the parsed XML condition.

methods.name: getHavingEntityCondition
methods.description: Generates the 'having' condition for the entity query based on the parsed XML condition.
